column2: When activated, this spell finishes the cooldown on all of your Frost spells.
When activated, your spells deal 30% more damage while costing 30% more mana to cast. This effect lasts 15 sec.

When active, 30% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter demon instead. In addition, both the demon and master will inflict 3% more damage. Lasts as long as the demon is active.
When used, adds 2 combo points to your target. You must add to or use those combo points within 10 sec or the combo points are lost.
While active, any time an enemy strikes the caster they have a 35% chance to become afflicted by Entangling Roots (Rank 1). Only useable outdoors. 1 charge. Lasts 45 sec.
While fishing with a Lure active, you have a 25% chance to catch an extra fish.

You gain talent points every level starting at level 5 instead of starting at level 10, but you still may not have more than 51 total talent points.
You have a 10% chance to receive 100% increased Merchant's Favor when you turn in a crate to the Azeroth Commerce Authority or Durotar Supply and Logistics.
You retain up to 10 Rage when you change Stances.
Your Healing Wave spells have a 33% chance to increase the effect of subsequent Healing Wave spells on that target by 6% for 15 sec. This effect will stack up to 3 times.

Your Scorch spells have a 33% chance to cause your target to be vulnerable to Fire damage. This vulnerability increases the Fire damage dealt to your target by 3% and lasts 30 sec. Stacks up to 5 times.
Your Shadow Bolt critical strikes increase Shadow damage dealt to the target by 4% until 4 non-periodic damage sources are applied. Effect lasts a maximum of 12 sec.

Your Shadow damage spells have a 20% chance to cause your target to be vulnerable to Shadow damage. This vulnerability increases the Shadow damage dealt to your target by 3% and lasts 15 sec. Stacks up to 5 times.
Your class abilities no longer require reagents purchaseable from vendors, and your Tier 1 camping features cost no reagents to craft.
Your critical strikes from Cat Form abilities that add combo points have a 50% chance to add an additional combo point.
Your critical strikes from abilities that add combo points have a 20% chance to add an additional combo point.
Your gnomish ingenuity reduces the rate of engineering devices failing or backfiring when you use them by 20%.
Your skin becomes as tough as bark. Physical damage taken is reduced by 20%. While you are protected, damaging attacks will not cause spellcasting delays. Lasts 15 sec.
Your spells and attacks have a chance (5% for casters, 10% for melee) to drain Health from the target, up to 5% of your maximum Health. 1 sec internal cooldown.
Your tallstrider kicks up an abrasive cloud of dust, reducing the target's Armor by 175 for 30 sec.
